newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila overnight borrowing rate raised to 11 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila overnight borrowing rate raised to 11 pct.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank on Wednesday raised its overnight borrowing rate to 11 percent from 10.25, Central Bank Treasurer Sergio Edeza said.
It left its overnight lending rate unchanged at 12.65 percent.
"This is a preemptive move. This is just to calm the market," Edeza told Reuters.
He said the the peso was still relatively stable.
Traders earlier said the Central Bank had to unload over $100 million at 26.37/26.375 to satisfy a jittery market over possible large outflows due to the plunge in the local stock market.
Edeza declined comment on whether the Central Bank had intervened in the market.
